issue.title: More memory-history surfaces: path@rev refs for sase pager, side-by-side diffs at 190+ columns, per-host rendered home instruction history

task_type_fields.proposal: Three related history surfaces: (1) path@rev refs accepted by sase pager to open a file at a revision; (2) a side-by-side diff layout in the pager diff view when the terminal is at least 190 columns wide; (3) history of per-host rendered home instruction files (the deployed output, not only the chezmoi source).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Listed in plan:202609/memory_history.md section 18 (Non-goals and follow-ups) and recorded by launch phase sase-1dr.12 as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; the memory-history epic sase-1dr deliberately shipped without it, and its land agent triaged it here. (note #6)

issue.creation_reason: Filed from sase-1dr.12 note #6 while landing epic sase-1dr.
